scope: Current character-art decisions; not runtime combat configuration.

standard_combat_stance.name: Stalker
standard_combat_stance.user_instruction: Let's actually do A / stalker pose from the last set of options for her standard combat stance.
requirements: Use A as drawn: wide staggered feet, front knee bent, rear leg extended, forward-loaded low torso.
Keep the longer right-hand knife low and the shorter left-hand knife close to the chest, pointing down.
Preserve the selected pose's shoulder side, weapon identities and mature anatomy.
standard_combat_stance.supersedes: Earlier B/F narrow-leg preference and G–J upper-body refinements; do not create an A/B/F hybrid.

requirements: Black swept hair (#111318, cool charcoal highlights); preserve cut and volume.
Lean athletic arms, about 20–25% slimmer; preserve arm length, joints and hands.
Keep A / Stalker stance, costume, strong legs and fixed knife geometry.

hair.user_instruction: He should keep his long hair but reduce the volume of it
requirements: Keep long white hair reaching the upper-to-mid back.
Lower the crown and narrow the outward fan; hair follows the skull, nape and back.
Use fewer grouped locks and restrained ends instead of a radiating spiky mane.
Retain loose hair; no added tie, braid, shaved side or shortened cut.
Carry the slimmer silhouette into motion without inflating it back into the old mane.
Physical cobalt-blue sports glasses with blue lenses, visible bridge and temple arms.
Natural skin around the glasses; remove all teal face paint / eye mask.
Keep guild-teal costume colors separate from the blue eyewear accent.

standard_combat_stance.name: Shoulder Rest
standard_combat_stance.user_instruction: F shoulder rest is definitely the right one.
requirements: Relaxed upright stagger and confident expression.
Right hand stabilizes the hooked shaft across / behind the shoulders; hook and butt remain visible.
Left hand holds the separate short triangular blade low.
Retain low-volume long white hair and physical blue sports glasses.
Depart from and return to current F / Shoulder Rest idle.
Keep blue sports glasses and low-volume long white hair.
Compact shoulder-led slashes; deeper scoop for two-hit 2Hs.
Use Ky P/K/S/Hs source normals; exclude all D attacks and specials.
Preserve right-hand hook, left-hand short blade, fixed anatomy and weapon scale.
User rejected stiff first production poses; do not use the first normals_0..3 generations.
Lead with hips and weight transfer, twist shoulders against pelvis, vary spine angle; feet pivot and heels lift naturally.
Use compressed windup, extended contact, relaxed overshoot and settling recovery; fixed anatomy scale does not mean fixed posture.

standard_combat_stance.name: Open Current
requirements: Upright, close legs, open low palms; forefeet lightly contact the ground with lifted heels.
Keep olive hood, dark hair and ivory alchemist costume.
Gentle buoyant breathing, trailing cloth/hair and separate gray/olive rear smoke.

crouching_stance.name: Uncoiled Vapor
requirements: Low asymmetric crouch: rear leg folded, leading knee raised, leading hand relaxed over that knee.
Suspended hips, light forefoot contact, trailing open hand and upward drifting cloth.
Use fixed anatomy scale; do not enlarge the crouch to standing height.

walk.name: Suspended Sway
walk.user_instruction: G3 is good move with that
requirements: Separate forward-leaning advance and backward-leaning retreat; keep facing the opponent.
Close legs, raised heels and light toe contact without a stepping walk.
Hair, ivory coat and separate rear vapor trail opposite travel.

run.name: Regal Surge
run.user_instruction: R4 for the run. walk cycle should be more of a drift leaning forward or back
requirements: Near-upright modest forward lean, low open palms, compact alternating leg curls.
Quicker cloth and rear vapor than walking; light toe skims.
Retain A/H identity and grounded gameplay; no transition smears.

specials.poison: Venom Sabre (S2) effect with S1 backhand motion
specials.fire: Furnace Cleaver (F2) effect with F1 backhand motion
specials.pillar: P2 Smoked Obsidian, identical art and size at close/far placement
requirements: No physical sword, hilt or handle; both hands empty.
Horizontal arcs parallel with ground; no shot beam.
Near/far use identical pillar art and size. Perspective size difference on concept board is rejected.
No transition smears.
